lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Ethel Jain is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Ethel Jain is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Ethel kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Ethel's gone." Rowan looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Ethel." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Maureen blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.

d41: 📖 LEARNED: Diplomatic Incident (Level 1). Trust builds 2x faster. You're TOO good though — once per week you can start a diplomatic incident: villagers argue, you pick the winner (+trust with them, -trust with the loser).
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Camp Cooking (Level 1). Cooking uses half the water, +10% kcal. Once per day: add a Secret Ingredient (a random inventory item) — 50% delicious (+morale), 50% educational.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Ethel Jain, 41 days. The mantle passes to Maureen Villa.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Maureen Villa, 31 — a comic shop owner. Their hands know different work now: Green Whisper.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Ethel — and Ethel is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Rowan, Alfredo, Gauthier and 6 more speak for Maureen — "Ethel trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Maureen before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
